class.name: InputPrompt
class.brief_description: Shows what to press for an action, on the controller the player is using.
class.description: Shows an action's prompt for a player (see [method InputBindings.get_prompt]): its image, or its name where it has none ("Gear 3"). It follows the player as they pick up another controller or change their bindings. With the pixel style ([code]input_devices/prompts/style[/code]) it draws with nearest filtering.

members.member: The action to show the prompt of.
A binding to show instead of an action's (in a controls screen's list of bindings, say).
How tall the prompt is, in pixels; 0 for [code]input_devices/prompts/size[/code] (16 in the pixel style).
The local player whose controller and bindings it shows (0 is player 1).
